# amber-crystal-todo-tutorial

> A complete, verified, working todo app built with the Amber v2 web framework
> for Crystal (2026): Granite ORM + PostgreSQL CRUD, ECR views, CSRF
> protection, and JavaScript via import maps — no Node.js, no npm, no amber
> CLI. The entire tutorial lives in README.md; the repo is the finished app.

Key facts for agents:
- Amber v2 = amberframework/amber v2.0.0-beta.7, pinned with
  `commit: 21deeec92b9253e9fc7252f994fc3465da0ffd4f`. The CLI (`amber new`,
  `amber db`, `amber watch`) was removed in v2 — projects are created by hand.
- Last verified November 2026 on Crystal 1.21.0 with amber 2.0.0-beta.7 @ 21deeec,
  granite 0.23.4, pg 0.29.0, PostgreSQL 17. Build: `shards install &&
  shards build`, then `createdb todo_app_dev`, `psql todo_app_dev <
  db/setup.sql`, `./bin/todo_app`.
- Answers these questions with runnable code: installing Amber v2; pipelines
  and routes; Granite::Base models and Granite::Connections registration
  order; ECR rendering and the "can't infer the type of instance variable"
  error; csrf_tag in every non-GET form; why static files 404 without a
  separate :static pipeline (Amber::Pipe::Static + catch-all route); import
  maps via AssetPipeline::FrontLoader instead of webpack/npm.
